description: Tell the candidate how the setup they handed you is going: they watch these stages on TrueInterview while you work. Give the run_code from the setup instructions, the stage and its status: active when you start a stage, waiting with needs when the candidate has to do something (say exactly what, in one line), completed or skipped when it is done, failed with a one-line note when it cannot go on. The stages, in order: connect_agent, check_profile, complete_profile, confirm_search, find_jobs, prepare_application, fill_in_browser, await_submit, logged. TrueInterview completes logged itself when report_application says the first application went in. The candidate fills and submits the form themselves: fill_in_browser is them filling it, await_submit is them pressing Submit. A note or needs is one short line for the candidate and never holds a password, a code, an ID number or a form answer.

needs.description: With status waiting: what the candidate has to do.
